name: app-shater-onboarding-language-and-signup-screens-with-hand-mockup
title: Shater onboarding: hand-held hero phone above ten language, welcome and signup screens
whatItIs: A light page with a numbered 'تطبيق العميل' (Client App) title, a hand holding the app's home screen, and ten sequential onboarding screens below: two handshake intros, a notification preview, a feature carousel, a splash logo, welcome screens with phone-number and OTP fields, and a language picker listing Arabic, English, French, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali and more.
whatItMeans: Inclusive and thorough; a full language list signals the product was built for a genuinely international audience.
techniques: Sequence onboarding screens left to right in reading order.
Offer a wide language list with flags for recognition.
Use OTP verification for a lightweight signup.

vocabulary.definition: One-time password sent to verify a phone number.
A screen for choosing the app's display language.
